description: Tracey Mann served as the 50th Lt Governor of the great state of Kansas. Tracey is a fifth-generation Kansan, he was born and raised on his family farm just south of Quinter. Tracey and Audrey live in Salina with their 4 children (Quincy, Austin, Whitney and Elise).
